title: Becoming

inlines.v: BECOM'ING, ppr., but used rarely or never except as an adjective. Fit; suitable; congruous; proper; graceful; belonging to the character, or adapted to circumstances; as, he speaks with becoming boldness; a dress is very becoming Some writers formerly used of, after this word. Such discourses as are becoming of them. But this use is inelegant or improper. BECOM'ING, adjective Ornament. obsolete
